budget.basis: Predeclared engineering targets, not a measured 100000-image baseline. RSS adopts the existing 464 MiB capacity target. GC requires conservative per-pause histogram upper bounds of at most 50 ms and both completed-cycle counter and histogram upper-sum ratios of at most 1%. The single workload uses distinct local sources from three repeated templates, two HTTP clients, default image and password budgets, and no forced collection or cooldown. The 1-hour bound limits test resources and is not a speed SLA.

method.originalsEvidence: read-only mount plus bounded samples; no claim of full before/after hashing

smoke.containerEvidenceBasis: Original Docker inspect was validated by the native controller; its safe projection is retained. Publication rechecks raw cgroup readings and does not re-inspect removed containers.

initialNativeFailure.causeAndFix: Every cold JPEG output reserved its full 2 MiB encoded-output cap. The processor now grows from at most 4 KiB as needed, doubling up to the same hard cap; decoder, slot, cache and acceptance limits are unchanged.

knownInitialFailure.fix: Only Linux test fixture moved to owned native temporary directory; controller checks unchanged
